open_points.subject: Repair-view trace paging for one slot
open_points.text: "`store.page_records` pages one record type in reverse store order under a filter of field equalities the caller gives" ... "surface ... pages the function-node NodeExecutions pinned to them"
open_points.question: How must `surface` obtain one correctly ordered, pageable stream of NodeExecutions pinned to any of several contract_version_ids when `store.page_records` is defined as equality-filter only?
options: Have `surface` issue multiple equality queries and merge/slice pages itself
Add a denormalized field (for example `slot_id`) on NodeExecution and page by one equality

open_points.subject: Owner of effect-class value set during binding validation
open_points.text: "No other module looks at effect classes."
open_points.question: Does `bindings` validate manifest `effect_class` against `data_provider.EFFECT_CLASSES`, or is `bindings` expected to hardcode/accept values independently despite owning A08 proposal checks?
options: `bindings` imports and uses `EFFECT_CLASSES` for membership checks
`bindings` accepts any string and leaves class validation elsewhere

open_points.subject: Ownership of StoredValue creation for authored constants
open_points.text: "StoredValue M21 and value bytes are written by whichever module produces the value"
open_points.question: Which module owns writing StoredValue records/bytes for flow constants (M16), which are authored literals rather than runtime-produced outputs?
options: `flows` writes StoredValues for constants at composition time
`store` synthesizes them implicitly from FlowConstant payloads
open_points.default_guess: `flows` writes StoredValues for constants during composition.
